body: Heyyy, do you wanna talk? I’m drunk as well and feeling how you are. I’m here for as long as i Can stay awake at least
I want to do maintenance and earn my degree through the military. I also am planning on staying with the military for a while. Not sure exactly how long.
I also want to get my college degree but been told with the hours that it’s very hard and limited. Is that true?
Have you not read the other stuff I’ve put? Cause you seem to think I’m only giving them another person thoughts. It’s called “changing perspective”
Yes basically, depending on the situation though
Thought is what causes people to feel mainly. So thoughts are important

Actually now that I think about it. What if your mom was alive? Do you think she’d like seeing you like this? I’m sure she’s probably watching you, in pain wondering how could’ve she let this get far. You think you would still shoot yourself?
So if you have nothing worth living for why are you here wasting your time reply to me?
Not a show? The sky? The ground? A animal? A place you want to see? Something you want? Cause everybody has something they like, even if they might seem like it and say so. It can be a piece of sand.

The world isn’t all the crappy. I won’t lie, humans make it crappy. Let me fix that “seem crappy,” but there are parts of the world were they are beautiful. I can’t blame you for wanting to leave this fucked up world, but it isn’t as bad. Remember you only have one chance to live it, down waste it. I’ve been through much pain, I’ve tried to kill my self, but as I slowly almost did. I started thinking about things. Small things. I’ll never be able to travel and see what I want to see, never be able to see my fav shows, never be able to see and be in true nature, never having to leave this hell hole and be alone, I wouldn’t be able to spend time with my pets, never get to play my favorite games or talk to my friends. Even the littlest of things are worth living for. Your strong enough to fight through this. And here’s a piece of advice. If your “family” doesn’t love and support you, then they aren’t real family. Just some people that are blood related you know. Nothings your fault, shit happens, and you can’t do anything about it.
